people.name: Tomáš Garrigue Masaryk
people.nameZh: 托馬斯·加里格·馬薩里克

body.zh-Hant: 馬薩里克1850年3月7日生於摩拉維亞的戈丁（今霍多寧）。他自1872年起在維也納大學攻讀古典與現代語言，1876年獲哲學博士。1882年他成為新設的布拉格捷克大學的哲學與社會學副教授；挪威百科則寫他自1882年起是布拉格的哲學教授。
body.en: Masaryk was born on 7 March 1850 in Göding (Hodonín) in Moravia. From 1872 he studied classical and modern languages at the University of Vienna, and he took his doctorate in philosophy in 1876. In 1882 he became an associate professor of philosophy and sociology at the newly founded Czech university in Prague; the Norwegian encyclopedia says he was a professor of philosophy in Prague from 1882.

stud. er an der Univ. Wien ab 1872 klass. und moderne Sprachen
(1876 Dr.phil.)
1882 ao. Prof. der Phil. und Soziol. an der neugegründeten Tschech. Univ.
Fra 1882 var Masaryk professor i filosofi i Praha

heading.zh-Hant: 帝國議會議員與現實主義者黨
heading.en: Reichsrat deputy and the Realist party

body.zh-Hant: 1891年，馬薩里克以青年捷克黨代表的身分當選帝國議會議員，1893年辭去議席。1900年他創立捷克人民黨。1907年他以現實主義者黨成員身分重回帝國議會眾議院；據奧地利議會的新聞稿，他是其政黨唯一當選的候選人，在議會活動到1914年。
body.en: In 1891 Masaryk was elected to the Reichsrat as a representative of the Young Czechs, and in 1893 he gave up the mandate. In 1900 he founded the Czech People's Party. In 1907 he returned to the House of Deputies as a member of the Realist party; according to an Austrian Parliament press release he was the only candidate of his party to be elected, and he was active there until 1914.

wo er bis 1914 wirken sollte

heading.en: Wartime exile and the independence campaign

body.zh-Hant: 第一次世界大戰爆發後的1914年，馬薩里克離開國土，流亡英國與美國，在當地籌備捷克人的民族革命。挪威百科記他在1916年於巴黎成立捷克斯洛伐克民族委員會一事上居於核心；奧地利傳記辭典則說他爭取斯洛伐克人支持共同的捷克斯洛伐克國家（1917年匹茲堡協定），1918年又透過影響威爾遜總統，取得對一個捷克斯洛伐克流亡政府的承認，並出任其領導人。
body.en: When the First World War broke out in 1914, Masaryk left the country and went into exile in Britain and the United States, where he worked to prepare a national revolution of the Czechs. The Norwegian encyclopedia says he was central to founding the Czechoslovak National Council in Paris in 1916; the Austrian biographical dictionary says he worked to win the Slovaks for a common Czechoslovak state (Pittsburgh Agreement, 1917) and that in 1918, by influencing President Wilson, he secured recognition of a Czechoslovak exile government, at whose head he stood.

body.zh-Hant: 1918年11月，馬薩里克被選為總統；奧地利傳記辭典記他1918、1920、1927與1934年四度當選國家元首，並於1935年因年事已高辭職。德國權威檔稱他為捷克斯洛伐克首任總統（1918至1935年）。他於1937年9月14日在布拉格近郊的拉尼城堡去世。
body.en: In November 1918 Masaryk was elected president. The Austrian biographical dictionary says he was chosen head of state in 1918, 1920, 1927 and 1934 and resigned in 1935 for reasons of age. The German authority file calls him the first state president of Czechoslovakia (1918-1935). He died on 14 September 1937 at Lana castle near Prague.

people.name: Anastasio Somoza García
people.nameZh: 阿納斯塔西奧·蘇慕薩·加西亞

heading.zh-Hant: 出身、美國求學與早期公職
heading.en: Birth, schooling in the United States and early public posts

body.zh-Hant: 索摩查1896年2月1日生。他曾在費城上學，年輕時在費城住了六年。美國外交官1932年的報告說他在美國受教育，是會計專業畢業生，先後擔任過總司令部（Comandancia General）秘書、外交部副部長與代理外交部長。報告日期為1932年11月21日，稱他是外交部「前」副部長，剛以助理身分進入國民警衛隊。
body.en: Somoza was born on 1 February 1896. He attended school in Philadelphia and, as a young man, lived there for six years. A 1932 US diplomatic report says he was educated in the United States as a graduate accountant and had served as Secretary of the Comandancia General and later as Under-Secretary and Acting Minister for Foreign Affairs. The report, dated 21 November 1932, calls him the late Under-Secretary of the foreign ministry and says he had just entered the National Guard as an assistant.

citations.quote: b. 1 February 1896; d. 29 September 1956

heading.zh-Hant: 國民警衛隊首長與1936年政變
heading.en: Chief of the National Guard and the 1936 ouster

body.zh-Hant: 美方1932年的報告預告索摩查將在馬修斯將軍離任後、約1933年1月初接任警衛隊總司令（Jefe Director）；1952年的美國國務卿備忘錄寫他1933年成為隊長（Director General）。百科條目說他在1934年安排桑地諾被殺，並在1936年推翻薩卡薩。薩卡薩等人事後致美國國務卿的信指稱，警衛隊長索摩查自行提名為總統候選人。
body.en: The 1932 US report said Somoza would take over as Jefe Director of the Guardia, in early January (rendered 1933 by the editors), when General Matthews left; the 1952 memorandum by the US Secretary of State says that in 1933 he became Director General of the National Guard. The encyclopedia entry says he arranged Sandino's murder in 1934 and ousted Sacasa from the presidency in 1936. A letter from Sacasa and others to the US Secretary of State later alleged that Somoza, head of the Guard, nominated himself a candidate for President.

heading.zh-Hant: 當選總統與掌控警衛隊
heading.en: Election as president and control of the Guard

body.zh-Hant: 百科條目說，索摩查在1936年12月被「選為」總統，任內仍掌有警衛隊最高指揮權，並重建民族自由黨作為個人政治機器。1952年的美國備忘錄說他在選舉中壓倒性獲勝，1937至1947年任總統。美國國務院的尼加拉瓜國家頁記載，1947年5月25至26日，卸任的前總統索摩查從阿爾圭略總統手中奪取政權。
body.en: The encyclopedia entry says Somoza was "elected" president in December 1936, kept supreme command of the National Guard while in office, and rebuilt the Nationalist Liberal Party as a personal political machine. The 1952 US memorandum says he won the vote overwhelmingly and served as president from 1937 to 1947. The US State Department country page records that on 25-26 May 1947 the former president seized control of the country from President Argüello.

body.zh-Hant: 1952年美國國務卿備忘錄說，他當時的任期為1950至1957年。百科條目寫，詩人里戈韋托·洛佩斯·佩雷斯在萊昂向他開槍，他被美國大使送往巴拿馬的美軍醫院，並在那裡去世；該條目記他死於1956年9月29日。
body.en: The 1952 memorandum by the US Secretary of State says his term then ran from 1950 to 1957. The encyclopedia entry says the poet Rigoberto López Pérez shot him in León, that he was airlifted to the American military hospital in Panama, where he died, and gives his date of death as 29 September 1956.

heading.zh-Hant: 榮赫鵬遠征與英國授爵
heading.en: The Younghusband expedition and the British knighthood

body.zh-Hant: 1903至1904年榮赫鵬（Younghusband）遠征西藏期間，不丹方面給予協助，烏顏·旺楚克是主要協助者之一。1905年1月2日，英國印度事務部宣布授予「通薩總督烏顏·旺楚克」印度帝國勳章爵級司令，《倫敦憲報》所載名字寫成Sri Offen Wang Chuk。
body.en: During the Younghusband expedition to Tibet of 1903-4, Bhutan gave assistance, with Ugyen Wangchuck among its main providers. On 2 January 1905 the India Office announced an appointment of the Tongsa Penlop of Bhutan, rendered in the London Gazette as Sri Offen Wang Chuk, as a Knight Commander of the Order of the Indian Empire.

body.en: An article in a Cambridge University Press journal says he was installed with British approval and local support as the first hereditary monarch in 1907, the year the hereditary monarchy was established on 17 December.

heading.en: The 1910 Treaty of Punakha and his death

body.zh-Hant: 劍橋期刊論文記載，貝爾（Bell）1910年1月7日抵達普那卡，條約1910年1月8日在不丹簽署。論文稱烏顏·旺楚克為「Maharaja」，並提到1911年他曾致函西藏的中國駐藏大臣，也說這第一位國王於1926年去世。
body.en: The Cambridge journal article records that Bell arrived in Punakha on 7 January 1910 and that the Treaty of Punakha was signed in Bhutan on 8 January 1910. It refers to Ugyen Wangchuck as the Maharaja, mentions that in 1911 he wrote to the Chinese Amban in Tibet, and says the first king died in 1926.
